baseline: End of batch 9: compiled theorem sources and exact historical specializations; publication commit and global audit are recorded by the main task.

methodology.excluded_from_statement_denominator: Definitions, remarks, proof paragraphs, discussion, bibliography; their necessary mathematical work is included in effort blocks.
methodology.no_independent_69_denominator: Companion A.1,A.2,B.1 duplicate/expand 2.3,3.13,4.2; other companion arguments also feed article endpoints.
methodology.complete_rule: All mathematical conclusions of a numbered result are covered by compiled explicit overlay representations or verified exact historical specialization. A building block or weaker quantitative rate gets no full credit. Equivalent epsilon/power forms of o(1) and finite positive F_Y-atom conditioning are accepted with their representations stated.
methodology.workload_rule: The same 19 blocks and 105 weighted units as the lot-8 baseline; an estimate of acquired proof and integration work over the whole article and companion, not a count of Lean declarations, hours, elapsed time, or a probability of correctness.
methodology.literature_boundary: Allows explicit source-faithful audited literature premises, as in the historical qualification. Does not include internally proving every external theorem in the bibliography; that stronger goal would require a new workload estimate.
methodology.unverified_reuse: Names found without a checked sufficient signature receive only component/presumed credit, not complete status.
methodology.validation_scope: Read-only source/signature assessment combined with successful direct compilations and the final coordinated global build (4270 jobs), 830-declaration axiom audit and 8 guard tests reported by the main task. This assessment introduces no theorem or new qualification.

effort.rounding_note: Calculated range is about 54–65%; the communicated 50–65% is deliberately rounded outward at the lower end. The approximate central figure 60% is not a measured statistic.
